name: room
text: Room opened — goal: accessibility: Make EXCAVA usable by EVERYONE — contrast, mobile/touch, reduced-motion, keyboard nav, scr

name: Ramp
text: Adopt a 4px focus ring at 7:1 contrast with no glow. This guarantees visibility for keyboard users without adding visual noise. The trade-off is slightly larger focus rings, but it ensures clarity for users with low vision or in bright environments.

name: Reader
text: A 4px ring at 7:1 contrast still fails on patterned or high-contrast backgrounds where the ring blends into the noise. A 2px ring at 4.5:1 with a subtle 1px glow (20% opacity) survives busy layouts without bloating the ring. Test with a 100px checkerboard at 50% gray—if the ring stays visible, the alternative wins.
